title: Rook Leads, Queen Mates
setup: Your rook and queen are stacked on the e-file, facing Black's rook on e8 and its queen on d7.
hint: Two heavy pieces on one file can only strike in one order. Work out which of them must go first.
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook stands in front, so it strikes first: {{Rxe8+}} forces {{Qxe8}}, and the queen behind it delivers {{Qxe8#}}. Reverse the order and there is nothing — the queen can never reach e8 with its own rook in the way.
